assets.name: indoor-clean
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this medieval farmhouse interior into an EMPTY PICKUP CLEAN PLATE for an interactive game. Preserve the exact camera, room silhouette, door opening bottomcenter, all furniture locations/dimensions, walls, floor, window, light, palette and painted pixel style. Remove ONLY all loose collectible supplies: bottle and folded linen from small left table; green coat and cream blanket from lowerleft stool and the two shoes on floor below; two books from center table; bread, cheese, bacon from upperright long counter; all pitchers, bottle/waterskin and hanging leatherstrap from smallright shelf. Leave every emptied table/stool/shelf wood surface naturally reconstructed. Keep stationary pottery/baskets under the food counter, keep CLOSED wooden cabinetright unaltered. Do not add any new item, person, symbol, words or interface. Exact same framing near16:9, highresolution detail, no extra artificial pixel reduction. This is an edit not a redesign.

assets.name: bridge-walk
assets.prompt: Use case: sprite-sheet game production. Image is identity/style reference for horse-drawn wooden wagon merchant and a group of THREE westbound bridge travelers(a jester with ochre/red hat, a brown featherhat luteplayer, a brown-haired backpacker). Create a transparent-background animation atlas with FOUR clearly separated equal-width cells in ONE horizontal ROW. All four silhouettes face EAST(right), runtime mirrorswest. Order: cell0 originalhorse-wagon left-legged walking pose; cell1 SAMEhorse/wagon/merchant with opposite horselegs forward and subtly rotated cartwheelspokes, allbodyposition/shape/size identical; cell2 allTHREE samewalkingtravelers in left-leg-forward gait; cell3 exactlySAMEthreecharacters with right-leg-forward gait. Clearly distinct feet/knees/arms strideposes between pair, no duplicated identicalframes, no extra people, no ghosted overlappinglimbs. Fine authoredpixelart in originalwarmbrown/ochre palette, same clothes/props/identities. Wagon silhouette horizontalwide, troupe horizontalwide withthreefullbodies. Each paired cell samebodyheight andsamebaseline, centersaligned, generous transparent gap/border. Canvaswide landscape2048x1024; eachquarter=onecompleteassetcentered on commonbaseline near75%height, noassetstraddlesquarterboundaries. No frameboxes, no labels, no lettering, no paintedbackground, actualalpha transparent. Outputwillnormalizeeachcellinto128x64withfootanchor[64,60].
